title: Dev F Progression barre stuck
symptom: With the last dev F, the progression bar gets stuck until next BG reading and stops data being sent to watch. Pulling on the Loop tab gives a black screen on loop and AutoISF. The problem seems only with AutoISF but also occurs with OpenSMB.
evidence_quote: With the last dev F, the progression barre gets stuck till next BG reading and stops data being sent to watch.
